name: Explosion Release: Flight of the Tsurubebi

sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Lightning Release, Earth Release, Stable, Reckless Branch

system.description:
You build up chakra in your palms, and the soles of your feet, and release it in bursts to fly short distances.

For the duration you gain two special actions called an Explosive Dash and a Volatile Movement. You gain each of these special actions at the beginning of each of your turns for the duration and can use both on the same turn.

Explosive Dash. You can spend this special action to gain a flying speed equal to your current speed until the end of your next turn as you release controlled explosive bursts to remain airborne until then.

Volatile Movement. When you spend this special action, the first time you move or when you end your movement for the turn (your choice) all creatures within 5 feet of you must make a Dexterity Saving throw, taking 3d8 force damage on a failed save or half as much on a failure. Damage dealt this way counts as casting a Hijutsu for the purposes of Bakuton clan features.
